evals.prompt: Run a full quality sweep of the Kalia codebase (architecture, documentation, code-quality, security) and produce a MoSCoW-categorized backlog and PR description.
evals.expected_output: A findings report grouped by MUST/SHOULD/COULD, each finding with a concrete file reference and one-sentence rationale, covering all four dimensions, plus a PR title/description that lists the findings inline rather than deferring to the diff.

assertions.text: Findings are categorized using MUST/SHOULD/COULD (MoSCoW) headers
Each finding has a concrete file reference (file:line where applicable)
The proposed PR description lists findings directly rather than saying 'see the diff'
No fabricated/invented findings when the underlying issue doesn't actually exist in the code
All four dimensions (architecture, documentation, code-quality, security) are represented, not just a subset
